label: Pot timing
tooltip: When to leave for Magic Pots and which ones to skip.

min_pot_fate_minutes_remaining.label: Skip pots with under (minutes left)
min_pot_fate_minutes_remaining.tooltip: Don't go to a pot FATE that is about to end. 0 = never skip.

pot_spawn_lead_minutes.label: Leave for pots this many minutes early
pot_spawn_lead_minutes.tooltip: This many minutes before the next pot appears, BOCCHI stops what it is doing and goes there.

fate_fallback_cutoff_minutes.label: Do not start FATEs within (minutes of pots)
fate_fallback_cutoff_minutes.tooltip: Don't start a normal FATE when the next pot is this many minutes away or less. 0 = always start FATEs.

ce_fallback_cutoff_minutes.label: Do not start CEs within (minutes of pots)
ce_fallback_cutoff_minutes.tooltip: Don't start a Critical Encounter when the next pot is this many minutes away or less. 0 = always start CEs.

should_farm_reroll_pot_chests.label: Also farm second-chance pot chests
should_farm_reroll_pot_chests.tooltip: After the pot chests, also check the second-chance chest spots while the buff still lasts.
